skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Soaring Will
skins.content: 0011 Yun Series New Arrivals/Soaring Will. Clothes based on the garb of the armed escorts of Yan, balancing traditional aesthetics with practicality. The youth aspires to shift mountains, his will soaring above the clouds.
skins.quote: He knows that whether you are a well-traveled armed escort or a mountain-crossing Messenger, only those stout of heart will be able to sweep their gaze across the clouds from above.
